task: Fix sub-workflow node input/output propagation bugs: rewrite _render_input() to use PREVIOUS_EXECUTION_STATE_ID, fix execute() to return last child state output, apply three null-guard fixes from code review (CR-001 parent_exec guard, CR-002 finished_child guard, CR-003 duplicate write removal), and add two WorkflowService helper classmethods.

technical_risk.label: M
technical_risk.risk_factors: Subtle state-key semantics change (PREVIOUS_EXECUTION_STATE_ID replaces context_store emptiness as first-after-START signal), Elasticsearch query ordering by update_date for find_last_execution_state_output on the critical execution path, backward-compatible signature addition to create_workflow_execution
technical_risk.mitigation: Well-established WorkflowService classmethod and Elasticsearch query patterns in the codebase; optional parameter addition is backward compatible; 19 node-level tests and 49 service-level tests provide coverage

key_reasoning.reason: Two components: SubWorkflowNode (_render_input() rewrite + execute() output fix + 3 null guards) and WorkflowService (2 new classmethods find_execution_state_output / find_last_execution_state_output, create_workflow_execution signature extended with parent_execution_id, get_nesting_depth and get_pool_enabled_workflow_configs also added). Coordination required across both but scope is well-bounded.

PREVIOUS_EXECUTION_STATE_ID detection change is semantically subtle — replaces context_store emptiness as the first-after-START signal. find_last_execution_state_output queries WorkflowExecutionState ordered by update_date descending via Elasticsearch and filters for SUCCEEDED status on the critical execution path. Both patterns follow established WorkflowService classmethod and ES query conventions already present in the codebase.

Three distinct layers: Workflow layer (SubWorkflowNode execution logic), Service layer (WorkflowService business logic), and DB-Persistence layer (WorkflowExecutionState reads via Elasticsearch in both new classmethods). No schema migration required; all changes are additive read-path additions.
